_tuning_notes: Savanna/badlands tortoise. worldgen_only true = Untamed Wilds style: spawns with newly generated chunks only, never naturally respawns — killing them permanently empties the area, and they drop nothing. shell_armor/shell_ticks tune the retreat (+8 armor, immobile, 10s). Breeds with sweet berries (breed_item), never tames. RARITY: tier 'uncommon' supplies the spawn weight; group_size and nearby_cap are pinned here (1-3, cap 4). nearby_cap denies natural spawns when that many of this animal are already within 64 blocks — the fix for persistent CREATURE mobs accumulating forever.
